issues.issue: Exhibit A gives no description, so 'other' with review is defensible. But other waiver reports put this same form line in utilities (Hordville, Elk Creek, Ong FY2024). The category is a judgment call. detail[6].category has the same issue.

issues.on_page: 24 Ending Balance 13,909.32; 28 Subtotal of Ending Balances '-'
issues.issue: Line 24 is the cash roll-forward result, not a printed fund balance or net position line. It is entered as equity while assets stay empty, because lines 26-28 are blank. As a result the balance sheet does not balance (0 vs 13,909.32). The report's own gap between lines 24 and 28 is already in report_discrepancies, but treating line 24 as equity is an assumption the extractor made.
